chunks: Then as he turned his face to Midian, he said: "Maybe my Lord will show me the right way."

key_terms.تِلْقَاءَ: Facing towards; in the direction of
key_terms.مَدْيَنَ: Midian, a region where Musa stayed

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Musa pray for when he traveled to Midian?
ai.summary: This verse captures the pivotal moment of Prophet Musa’s (peace be upon him) transition from royal prince to exile, highlighting his spiritual humility as he seeks divine guidance for the 'straight path' (Sawā’ al-Sabīl) amidst uncertainty. In Shia exegesis, this supplication is often viewed as a model for believers navigating periods of isolation and preparation for their ultimate mission, emphasizing that true direction comes from Allah alone. The journey to Midian serves as a preparatory phase where Musa learns patience and self-reliance before his prophetic calling.
